newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE BRANCH OUT INTO EDUCATION, HEALTH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE BRANCH OUT INTO EDUCATION, HEALTH.

text.p: Turkey's Fenerbahce club are to branch out into the field of education, opening a Fenerbahce high-school and planning a Fenerbahce University, club chairman Ali Sen was said on Thursday.

"This is the first step. In every city in various places, there will be Fenerbahce Colleges, infant schools, primary schools, high-schools and a university," Sen said at a ceremony founding the first Fenerbahce high-school in Istanbul.

The state-run Anatolian news agency reported that Sen said the building of the high-school, to be known as Fenerbahce College, was 80 percent complete and would be open for the next school year starting in September.
"The service offered to our country by Fenerbahce, is not just limited to sport. We also have a responsibility to the people of this country in education," Sen said.
There was also a project in the pipeline for a Fenerbahce hospital, he said.
Istanbul already has a Galatasaray high school, which gave rise to Turkey's oldest existing soccer club and Fenerbahce's greatest rival. But Galatasaray club does not own the school.
